properties.source: Same synthetic DEM as atlas; 2x downsample. Priority flood drainage, coarse relative precipitation, candidate basin markers, terrain/risk-aware terrestrial routes.
notes: River courses and outlet points schematic, not exact valleys or measured flows.
Lake symbols are candidate basins, not actual extents.
Land corridors connect candidate settlement nodes; no political boundaries, detailed road widths or seasonal maritime routes.
